description: 24-month causal recurrence-graph carrier with graph-aligned formation, neutral load, and recursive persistence.
domain: atmospheric CO2 / monthly Mauna Loa measurements

invariant_parameters.adaptive_family: two coefficients: intercept + standardized feature slope
invariant_parameters.matched_null: same coefficient count and same forecast endpoints

measurement_mapping.D: standardized monthly delay state with resource/phase embedding
measurement_mapping.K: graph-aligned formation operator with one rank-one negative mode
measurement_mapping.R_C: graph eigenbasis with persistent low modes and contractive complement
measurement_mapping.Y: PSD squared graph geometry plus scalar stress

name: Mauna Loa Monthly CO2 BFG Carrier
